FailureProtocol.ceilingMeaning: Preserve historical ceilings, not newly granted execution deadlines. Do not increase retries/timeouts/assertion windows, alter scoring/physics, reconstruct receipts, promote old PASS or retry failed producer delivery. Record partial/failure truthfully and stop.
